thread:
Olivia (CSM): Heads up — Lumenary prod API tokens showed a 68% drop starting 03/12 10:12 UTC. No infra alerts. Active seats look unchanged. Flagging renewal risk (renewal Apr 28). Anyone seen config changes or procurement notes?
Aaron (Eng): Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? If Hosted we can check routing/capacity, if Dedicated we need infra logs.
Olivia (CSM): Hosted, model pinned to redwood-embed-v2. No billing spikes. Maya (CTO) mentioned a procurement eval last week.
Alex (Data): Ran a quick query:
```
SELECT date, COUNT(*) as requests
FROM api_logs
WHERE customer_id='lumenary'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
Results: 03/11 -> 420k, 03/12 before 10:12 -> 410k, 03/12 10:12-16:00 -> 135k (~68% drop). Top lost traffic: /v1/generate
Mara (Support): No 5xx. Small 403 spike around 10:10 UTC — looks like a rotated key on client side. I've emailed Maya for confirmation and asked for their deploy/change notes.
Jess (Product): FYI: competitive intel shows NimbusAI started a pilot with Lumenary last week and shipped a summarization feature that may reduce token count. Could be product substitution rather than churn.
Sam (AE): I'll reach out to Maya today. @Olivia can you drop the usage dashboard and last two weeks' trend so I can prep? I'll try to lock a call this week.
Kevin (CSD): Triage plan: 1) outreach immediate 2) validate infra/keys 3) propose enablement session + ROI review 4) 2-week monitoring. If no rebound, escalate renewal risk. Can we commit to that?
Aaron (Eng): I'll check routing, latency and kernel fallback logs. Also pulling endpoint-level hits to see if they're switching endpoints.
Olivia (CSM): Action items: Alex -> post dashboard link; Aaron -> infra check post; Mara -> confirm token rotation & any inbound logs; Sam -> outreach + calendar; Jess -> competitor feature comparison; Kevin -> flag renewal risk and prep playbook. Proposed customer call Fri 16:00 PST. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled account-health export will run 03/13 02:00 UTC.
Sam (AE): Tentative call invite sent for Fri 16:00 PST to Maya (CTO) — cc @Olivia.
Alex (Data): Dashboard link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/lumenary-usage?range=14d — export attached (summary: weekly token spend down 62%, avg tokens per call down 43%).
Olivia (CSM): Noted. If usage doesn't rebound after enablement we escalate to AE leader. Keeping thread updated.
Kevin (CSD): Thanks team. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
